def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find divider(s): uniform non-bg lines
    hd=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    vd=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    # assume single divider per axis; shift = -(coord+1) toward smaller coords
    sh_d = None; sh_v = None
    if hd:
        d=hd[0]
        sh_d = -(d+1) if d>h//2 else (d-h+1)
        src_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r>d] if d<h//2 else [r for r in range(h) if r<d]
        tgt_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r<d] if src_rows and all(r>d for r in src_rows) else ([r for r in range(h) if r>d] if all(r<d for r in src_rows) else src_rows)
    if vd:
        d=vd[0]
        sh_v = -(d+1) if d>w//2 else (d-w+1)
        src_cols=[c for c in range(w) if c>d]; tgt_cols=[c for c in range(w) if c<d] if src_cols else ([c for c in range(w) if c>d] if all(c<d for c in src_cols) else src_cols)
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=bg and r not in hd and c not in vd:
                # source cell: copy into target region along the divider axis
                if hd:
                    rr=r+sh_d
                    if 0<=rr<h and g[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=v
                if vd:
                    cc=c+sh_v
                    if 0<=cc<w and g[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=v
    return out

def analyze(k):
    inp,out=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hd=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg]
    vd=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(inp[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and inp[0][c]!=bg]
    print('===',k,'bg=',bg,'hd=',hd,'vd=',vd)
    marks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bg and r not in hd and c not in vd]
    print('markers:',marks)
    # diff structure: which cells changed
    changed=[(r,c,inp[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=out[r][c]]
    print('changed count:',len(changed))
analyze('Demo pair 1'); analyze('Demo pair 2')

import collections
def solve(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hd=sorted([r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg])
    vd=sorted([c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bg])
    divset={(r,c) for r in hd for c in range(w)}|{(r,c) for c in vd for r in range(h)}
    O={}
    srcs=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in divset]
    q=collections.deque(srcs)
    while q:
        p,v=q.popleft()
        r,c=p
        if (r,c) in O and O[(r,c)]==v: continue
        O[(r,c)]=v
        for line in hd:
            nr=2*line-r
            if 0<=nr<h and (nr,c) not in O: q.append(((nr,c),v))
        for line in vd:
            nc=2*line-c
            if 0<=nc<w and (r,nc) not in O: q.append(((r,nc),v))
    return [[O.get((r,c),g[r][c]) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

from collections import Counter
def info(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hd=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bgc]
    vd=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bgc]
    nd=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bgc,)+([x for r in hd for x in [g[r][0]]])*0 if g[i][j] not in set(g[r][0] for r in hd)]
    # noise: any cell with color neither bg nor the divider colors
    dc=set(g[r][0] for r in hd)|set(g[0][c] for c in vd)
    nd=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in ({bgc}|dc)]
    print(k,'size',h,w,'bg',bgc,'hdivs',hd,'vdivs',vd)
    print('  noise:',nd)
info('Demo pair 4')
print('test:',[(i,j) for i in range(len(G['Test input'])) for j in range(len(G['Test input'][0])) if G['Test input'][i][j]==5])

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hd=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    vd=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    dc=set(g[r][0] for r in hd)|set(g[0][c] for c in vd)
    def bands(divs,n):
        ds=[-1]+divs+[n]; return [(ds[i]+1,ds[i+1]) for i in range(len(ds)-1)]
    Rh=bands(hd,h); Rw=bands(vd,w)
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    # horizontal axis: copy noise from source row-band into every other row-band, aligned to band tops
    for si,(sa,sb) in enumerate(Rh):
        for ti,(ta,tb) in enumerate(Rh):
            if si==ti: continue
            base=ta-sa
            for (r,c) in [(i,j) for i in range(sa,sb) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in ({bg}|dc)]:
                rr=base+(r-sa)
                if ta<=rr<tb: o[rr][c]=g[r][c]
    # vertical axis: copy noise from source col-band into every other col-band, aligned to band left edges
    for si,(ca,cb) in enumerate(Rw):
        for ti,(ta,tb) in enumerate(Rw):
            if si==ti: continue
            base=ta-ca
            for (r,c) in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(ca,cb) if g[i][j] not in ({bg}|dc)]:
                cc=base+(c-ca)
                if ta<=cc<tb: o[r][cc]=g[r][c]
    return o
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
